Identified as this saint because: Found by listing `Category:Jovan Vladimir in icons`, a subcategory of `Category:Jovan Vladimir` — Commons' Serbian-form title, which is why `Category:Saint John Vladimir`, the title this folder's display name suggests, exists but is empty. The file's Albanian title is «Shën Gjon Vladimiri me skena nga jeta e tij», Saint John Vladimir with scenes from his life, a vita icon of the martyred king of Doclea; this folder is that man, display name «John Vladimir», Serbian form «Јован Владимир», types `king`, `martyr`, `wonderworker`, kept 22 May in the Greek, Russian and Serbian calendars. He is the central figure of a vita icon rather than one name in a group. 1392x2048. Commons describes it: Created by Kostandin Shpataraku, an Albanian Orthodox icon and fresco painter of the 18th-century Post-Byzantine period, this icon of Saint Jovan Vladimir, originally from the Ardenica Monastery in Albania, presents the saint seated on a throne at the center, surrounded by scenes illustrating key moments from his life and miracles, based on his Greek hagiography.
